trigger: Wraith's scent trail ends at the irrigation canal behind the block.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Nose down. Fast. Then she stops dead and sits, staring at the canal bank.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Mr. Pruitt is sitting on the bank in his slippers, throwing bread to ducks that aren't there.

nodes.speaker: pruitt
nodes.text: There you are. Thought the Air Force forgot about me.

choices.text: Let's get you home, Mr. Pruitt.
What are you doing out here?

nodes.speaker: pruitt
nodes.text: Ducks. The power's out. Somebody has to feed the ducks.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He leans on you all the way back. He weighs nothing. Deshawn runs the last half block.

nodes.speaker: deshawn
nodes.text: Grandpa! You can't do that. You can't just—

nodes.speaker: deshawn
nodes.text: Ms. Lolo says you gave the gas. I... thanks. For real. I owe you one.

nodes.speaker: deshawn
nodes.text: Thanks, man. Your dog's a genius. Grandpa, inside. Now.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Accepts one pat from Deshawn. Then comes straight back to your heel.]
